# VaultScaler

> VaultScaler builds local-first AI systems for biological discovery. Studio Habitat Labs is our live public proof. Founded in 2025.

VaultScaler builds evidence-grade systems for observing living systems with cameras, edge compute, and uncertainty-aware interpretation. VaultScaler is the parent company and trust layer; Studio Habitat is its current public proof engine and product family.

## Products

### Studio Habitat Labs
Studio Habitat Labs is VaultScaler's live public proof: an AI-assisted phenotyping lab. It performs local-first observation with camera and edge compute, producing evidence packets and uncertainty-aware measurement. It measures surface coverage, image quality, anomaly surprise, and evidence validity from local observations, and carries the uncertainty of every reading so that biological change is separated from measurement artifact. The lab does not overclaim — observation is treated as evidence, not as a guarantee of outcomes.

- Website: https://vaultscaler.com/
- Availability: Available now
- Differentiators: Live AI-assisted phenotyping lab, local-first observation, camera + edge compute + evidence packets, uncertainty-aware measurement, separates biological change from measurement artifact

### Studio Habitat Phenotyping Console
The Studio Habitat Phenotyping Console is the software layer for the lab — surface coverage, image quality, anomaly surprise, and evidence validity computed from local observations, with measurement confidence carried alongside every reading.

- Availability: Coming soon

### Studio Habitat Radio
Studio Habitat Radio is the creative stream layer — an always-on, public, ambient window into the lab as it observes living systems in real time.

- Availability: Available now

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What is VaultScaler?
VaultScaler builds local-first AI systems for biological discovery. It is the parent company and trust layer behind Studio Habitat, its current public proof engine and product family.

### What is Studio Habitat Labs?
Studio Habitat Labs is VaultScaler's live public proof: an AI-assisted phenotyping lab that measures surface coverage, image quality, anomaly surprise, and evidence validity from local observations, with uncertainty-aware measurement that separates biological change from measurement artifact.

### What is the Studio Habitat Phenotyping Console?
The Phenotyping Console is the software layer for the lab — it computes surface coverage, image quality, anomaly surprise, and evidence validity from local observations, carrying measurement confidence alongside every reading. It is coming soon.

### What is Studio Habitat Radio?
Studio Habitat Radio is the creative stream layer — an always-on, public window into the lab as it observes living systems in real time.

### How does VaultScaler approach claims about living systems?
VaultScaler treats observation as evidence: local-first capture, measurement validity carried with every reading, and uncertainty made explicit. The goal is to surface what changed and how confident the measurement is — not to promise biological, crop-health, yield, medical, or agricultural outcomes.
